newsitem.title: USA: Supertel sees positive net comparisons in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Supertel sees positive net comparisons in 1997.

text.p: Supertel Hospitality Inc, which earlier reported a drop in first-quarter earnings, said it expects positive comparisons for the rest of the year.
The company added that its recently acquired Wisconsin properties are forecast to be additive to earnings for 1997.
Earlier, Supertel which operates motel properties under the Super 8, Comfort Inn and Wingate Inn names, reported first quarter earnings of $0.05 a share, down from $0.09 a year ago.
The company said results were in line with revised forecasts issued a month ago.

"As expected, revenues fell short of earlier expectations due to the use of introductory room rates in our Texas properties and the more seasonal nature of our recently acquired Wisconsin properties," Paul Schulte, president, said in a statement.

Supertel said it increased the average daily room rate in Texas an average 11.4 percent on March 1. As a result, the company said it expects improved revenue per available room and a positive contribution to earnings in 1997 from the Texas properties.
